study.question: Does retaining the identity of separately retrieved category/brand evidence until the classifier improve target-conditional prediction beyond early addition, at matched allocated parameters and total history-vector norm? Observations: static/pooled/DIN AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. g2-r0001-target_separate reaches 0.6153351064 versus context_separate 0.6110239483 and target_consensus 0.6146090565. Its candidate-supplied 512-impression diagnostics report field-attention L1=1.48553. g2-r0002-union_target=0.6149204868 and crossed_target=0.6138332320 trail aligned_replay=0.6153351064. Source inspection shows the successful field-aligned reads are still added to a single 16-dimensional vector before the classifier; actual destructive cancellation or predictive information loss has not been measured.
study.hypothesis: Field-specific relevance can survive separate retrieval but become difficult to decode after addition. Keeping the two contributions in distinct classifier blocks may allow different downstream weights while preserving total norm. This is a provisional explanation, not a demonstrated bottleneck. The abandoned action-group directional branch (g2-r0000-target_directional AUC 0.6114152265, all four round-0 variants below DIN), failed whole-event union/crossing, and unsuccessful behavior-count correction (g2-r0003-action_target 0.6144010686; shifted_target 0.6134877323; action_context 0.6098383560) argue against assuming that more joint fusion or rarer-action mass is beneficial. Exact same-seed replays are reproducibility evidence, not independent repetitions. A local late-fusion test is warranted; it does not refute the earlier mechanisms generally.

nearest_work.difference: DIN already concatenates feature representations for an MLP and uses candidate-conditioned weighted history pooling. We inherit the local adapted relation MLP. This proposal contrasts separate retrieved field contributions against their sum, with two identical-width input blocks. Our softmax and fixed-norm adaptations differ from original DIN, which explicitly abandons softmax to retain intensity; this is not a faithful DIN reproduction or a new concatenation claim.

Prior work retains retrieved sequence tokens alongside field tokens, generates/refines probes, and uses multiple views. We do not introduce those components: only two existing aligned field reads and a shallow concatenation-versus-sum contrast. Local query-generation limitations remain unmeasured. Generic field/sequence fusion is established; global priority is unverified.

UniDot explicitly preserves interactions through a highway alongside iterative bus fusion. Here no highway, cross-dot features, repeated buses, auxiliary targets or mutual learning are used. We preserve two pooled vectors in classifier input slots; information preservation is a broad prior theme, not a source-specific transferred result.

inherited_components: Parent g2-r0001-target_separate: candidate.py initially matches its aligned event-level read design; last round g2-r0003-global_target is a recorded same-seed replay at AUC 0.6153351063827704.
Unchanged categorical embeddings including shared target/history category and brand tables; action and log2-age embeddings; shared DIN-style 4d relation scorer and separate masked field softmaxes.

Unchanged supplied causal histories (limit 128), static fields, frozen split/scoring, labels, all-example coverage, three host epochs, batch 4096, Adam lr=0.001 and hidden layers [128,64]. No optimizer/loss hook.
Target-independent masked-mean pooled norm as the total history norm reference; per-model learned embeddings mean reference magnitudes need not match numerically across trained variants.
Existing width-d incumbent and all negative branches retained as historical evidence, not replaced or silently recast as successes.
study.proposed_difference: Let c=sum_i wc_i*(category_i+common_i/2), b=sum_i wb_i*(brand_i+common_i/2), so c+b recovers the incumbent aligned read up to floating-point order. Late fusion passes [c;b]; the matched control passes [c+b;c+b]/sqrt(2). Both are rescaled to the norm of the original pooled history, with identical fallback [pooled;pooled]/sqrt(2) for a degenerate raw vector. All four modules have classifier history width 32 and identical allocated parameters: expected 17,132,323 total, 53,635 dense, +2,048 versus incumbent at d=16. No new attention heads or embedding tables. Cross late/sum with current-ad versus history-mean queries. The summed control is functionally representable by the narrower incumbent but has a different first-layer initialization and optimizer parameterization. This is a mechanism-distinct local fusion implementation, not a claim to have invented late fusion.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: validation AUC(target_late)-AUC(target_sum)>0, with target_late also exceeding historical incumbent 0.6153351064. Report unweighted Logloss and measured training/inference cost even if AUC improves.

If preserving target-specific field evidence is the reason, the interaction [AUC(target_late)-AUC(target_sum)]-[AUC(context_late)-AUC(context_sum)] should be positive. Equal gains would support generic field preservation rather than target-specific fusion.

Diagnostics should show near-zero padding mass and total-norm/isometry errors (roughly <=1e-5 relative), additive reconstruction error near roundoff, and nonzero field-attention difference. Branch-swap sensitivity should be exactly zero for duplicated-sum controls and can be nonzero for late fusion. These are candidate-supplied sanity/sensitivity measurements on 512 impressions, not performance attribution.

Inspect already frozen host slice bins for history length, hour, action presence, frequency and category matching, retaining counts of samples/positives/negatives. Any slice pattern is exploratory; no new bins selected from validation or claimed significance. Empty histories yield zero summaries, but separately trained models can still differ on that slice.
falsifiers: No target_late advantage over target_sum, or advantage only over the historical narrower incumbent, fails to support this implementation beyond width/parameterization effects. Retain null/negative results.
A nonpositive query-by-fusion interaction does not support the target-specific explanation even if late fusion helps both query conditions.
An AUC gain with large Logloss/cost regression is not an unqualified model improvement. No scientific significance claim from seed 42 or repeated exact replays.

Invalid finite logits, large norm/decomposition errors, or nonzero branch-swap sensitivity in sum controls indicate implementation/invariant failure rather than scientific counterevidence. Lack of late-fusion branch sensitivity weakens the distinct-field decoding account.
alternative_explanations: Wider classifier initialization, optimization geometry and branch gradient allocation can change performance even at equal allocated parameter count. Duplicated-sum controls have lower active input rank; representational rank is the intervention, not a matched nuisance.

Fixed total norm removes one scalar-amplitude explanation but relative branch amplitudes, angular geometry and learned embedding norms remain part of the intervention. Do not claim a pure semantic-direction effect.
A generic field-separation benefit may occur independently of current-ad queries. The complete factorial distinguishes this from a target-specific interaction.

One-seed variation, selection over many past validation trials, best-checkpoint selection, shared-user correlations, sparse/hashed fields and temporal shift can explain small deltas. Seed repetitions and paired user-cluster uncertainty are needed before repeated-support claims.

Publisher static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; the frozen benchmark assumption is not verified production point-in-time validity. No unavailable item IDs, delayed conversion targets, extra events or test feedback are introduced.

contrasts.intervention: target_late versus target_sum: retain two field-contribution blocks instead of duplicate their sum.
contrasts.control: target_sum; identical architecture, target query, dimensions, parameter initialization order and total-norm reference. Historical g2-r0003-global_target supplies the narrower incumbent quality/cost comparison.
held_fixed: embedding/scorer/output layer shapes across the four variants
separate softmaxes and aligned field values
remaining_confounds: active input rank and gradient allocation intentionally differ
sum control versus historical incumbent has wider first-layer parameterization
trained variants can learn different attention/embedding norms
contrasts.decision_if_supported: Repeat the candidate and matched controls on frozen paired seeds before interpreting mechanism or promoting it; retain cost and calibration evidence.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Keep incumbent; do not infer cancellation was present. Diagnose measured branch geometry before any follow-up rather than adding arbitrary complexity.

contrasts.control: History-mean query variants use the same scorer and all identical trainable tensors.
held_fixed: all four parameter shapes and total-norm policy
same host seed, exposure coverage and scoring
remaining_confounds: history-mean queries differ in distribution as well as target information
all models train end-to-end, so this is a trained-model contrast rather than a frozen-representation intervention
AUC differences are not additive causal effects
contrasts.decision_if_supported: A positive replicated interaction supports target-dependent benefit of this field-preserving readout, limited to this benchmark.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If late fusion helps equally under both queries, report a generic fusion result; if it fails both, retain both null trajectories and incumbent.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Frozen runtime protocol estimated_unit_seconds=704.3729729604242; nearest g2-r0003 controls cost 650.05-675.01 wall seconds. Four trials estimated 4*800=3,200 seconds including overhead; each remains subject to trial_cap_seconds=1760.9324324010606 (four-trial cap 7,043.73). remaining_seconds at initial resolution=74667.91335868835; all preparation and failures remain charged.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve 8,000 seconds for discriminating attribution or failed-implementation follow-up, including controls/diagnostics; no automatic duplicate execution when state is unknown. This proposal already spends four full units, not free screening.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 12,000 seconds for validation-only paired seeds 42/43/44 of the selected candidate, closest sum/context controls and incumbent as needed. The current seed-42 runs count toward the suite; do not label historical same-seed replays independent repetitions. No test request or closed-archive access is authorized.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Submit only these four variants in the propose phase. Host handles training and scoring. Do not install Torch or train in the coding jail. Before further experiments retain assessment/attribution reserves; stop on hard budget/trial cap, integrity failure, user stop or no useful admissible full unit. If repetition cannot fit, report preliminary single-seed conclusions; never raise limits or count proposal completion as scientific success.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary section 4.2 (arxiv:2609.16548v1 lines 128-192) was read. Appended retrieval tokens are prior art. Latest knowledge usage declared consideration; executed union and action-prior variants did not beat the aligned parent, so they establish neither query-generation need nor transferred source benefit.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No generated probes, bridge, Co-Transformer or independent views adopted. Ordinary concatenation is used to isolate a locally observed early-addition limitation.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Two inherited field reads feed a shallow MLP, without source token construction/refinement; global novelty unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: The four-way fusion result cannot validate/refute QueryFormer. A zero interaction rejects target-specific late-fusion interpretation here.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Retrieved card has organizer-summary detail only; no detailed primary mechanism was verified. Local field-alignment results motivate a fusion contrast but do not establish source token-allocation transfer.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No jointly projected fields, learned token allocation or gated decoder. All supplied events are retained.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: This compares two fixed input slots with duplicated additive slots at equal downstream allocated parameters; not a source reproduction.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: These experiments cannot validate or refute the source token-budget account; original full mechanism/ablation remains missing.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary arxiv:2608.16797v1 lines 163-207 were read. Its explicit information routes are relevant prior context, but latest declared non-adoption and failed count-prior trials provide no source-specific mechanism evidence.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No FM Highway, dots/Gram features, co-evolving buses, auxiliary heads, mutual learning or optimizer change. Preserve existing field readouts only.
